name: Gaichtpassstüberl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Gaichtpassstüberl in Tirol!**

Nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**, this cozy mountain hut offers a warm retreat after a day of hiking, skiing, or exploring the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**. Enjoy hearty **Tiroler** dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, and fresh mountain trout, paired with local **Tiroler** beers and wines.

Whether you're seeking relaxation by the fireplace or an unforgettable sunset over the **Karwendel** or **Zugspitze**, the **Gaichtpassstüberl** promises an authentic alpine experience. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, it’s the perfect stop for nature lovers and food enthusiasts alike.

Come and taste the true spirit of **Tirol**—where tradition meets breathtaking scenery!
